name: order-board
description: Order Board monorepo — Student + Staff Capacitor apps

scripts.sync: npm run sync-shared && npm run sync --workspace=order-board-student && npm run sync --workspace=order-board-staff
scripts.apk:student: npm run sync-shared && npm run apk --workspace=order-board-student
scripts.apk:staff: npm run sync-shared && npm run apk --workspace=order-board-staff
scripts.apk: npm run apk:student && npm run apk:staff
